definitions.explanation: A photograph one takes of oneself, usually with a smartphone. Borrowed from English and used mainly in fashion, beauty, and social-media writing; in everyday Japanese {自撮|じど}り is far more common.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}とセルフィーを{撮|と}った。
examples.english: I took a selfie with a friend.

examples.japanese: セルフィーが{上手|じょうず}に{撮|と}れるアプリを{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: I use an app that takes good selfies.

examples.japanese: {展望台|てんぼうだい}で、{街|まち}の{夜景|やけい}を{背景|はいけい}にセルフィーを{撮|と}った。
examples.english: At the observation deck, I took a selfie with the city's night view behind me.

notes:
From English 'selfie'. It reads as somewhat stylish or media-flavored; a learner who wants the neutral everyday word should use {自撮|じど}り.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- セルフィーを{撮|と}る: to take a selfie
- セルフィー{動画|どうが}: a self-filmed video
- セルフィーを{投稿|とうこう}する: to post a selfie

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自撮|じど}り: selfie — the standard Japanese word; also used as a verb with する
- {自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう}: selfie stick — always formed on {自撮|じど}り, never on セルフィー
